entries.title: data.police.uk — Crime and Policing Open Data
entries.description: Open street-level crime, outcome, and stop-and-search data for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, plus police force and neighbourhood information and police annual data requirement (ADR) returns, available as CSV downloads and an API.
entries.publisher: Home Office (United Kingdom), with police forces of England, Wales, and Northern Ireland

coverage.spatial: England, Wales, and Northern Ireland (street level, anonymised locations)

entries.attribution: data.police.uk, contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The site calls itself "the site for open data about crime and policing in England, Wales and Northern Ireland", with street-level crime, outcome, and stop-and-search downloads in CSV and an API. It states "All the data on this site is made available under the Open Government Licence v3.0". Several things come from the site's usual description and were not checked here: that the Home Office is the publisher, the monthly cadence, the rolling archive span, and json from the API.

entries.title: UNODC Data Portal
entries.description: The UN Office on Drugs and Crime's statistical portal covering intentional homicide, trafficking, prison populations, corruption, and access-to-justice indicators across UN member states.
entries.publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200, redirects to data.unodc.org). Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
